name: features-tabs
title: Tabbed product tour
description: Product tour with animated tabs; each tab pairs short copy and a checklist with a Tailwind-built app mock.

standards.purpose: Explain what the product does through scannable capabilities rather than a wall of prose.
useWhen: A section must show three to six distinct capabilities.
Each item reduces to a short title plus one supporting line.
doNotUseWhen: The content is a sequence (use numbered steps).

rules.check: Each feature is a short title plus at most two lines of supporting copy.
All cards in one section share a single internal structure; do not mix icon, screenshot, and chart cards.
Screenshots and charts show real product UI, never fabricated interfaces.
